name: microapps
description: Host/base de microfrontends móviles con Expo + Re.Pack + Floci. Las mini apps viven en repos hermanos.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('@swc/core');console.log('✓ @swc/core OK')}catch(e){console.warn('⚠ @swc/core: corre npm approve-scripts @swc/core si el build de Re.Pack falla')}"
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently -n host,catalog,profile -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start -w host" "npm run start:catalog" "npm run start:profile"
scripts.prebuild: npm run prebuild -w host && node scripts/patch-native.js
scripts.typecheck:all: turbo run typecheck && npm run typecheck:catalog && npm run typecheck:profile
scripts.test:all: turbo run test && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:profile
scripts.verify: turbo run typecheck test && npm run lint
